proof: Skill-2 winappcli UI sign-off — real execution against PowerToys PowerRename

launch_mechanism.how: PowerToys.PowerRename.exe accepts selected file paths directly as quoted command-line arguments (the app's built-in UI-testing entry point).
launch_mechanism.evidence: src/modules/powerrename/PowerRenameUILib/PowerRenameXAML/App.xaml.cpp OnLaunched(): ParseCommandLineArgs(GetCommandLine()); if no named pipe present and cmdline files exist -> g_files = cmdline files. Confirmed by PowerRenameUITest base which launches with a file-path array.
launch_mechanism.non_destructive: Preview only — Apply is never clicked, so the sample files are never actually renamed on disk.

harness.isolation: One FRESH PowerRename instance launched per check, so every check starts from the default flag state (all checkboxes off). Required because PowerRename checkboxes only expose the UIA Toggle pattern (no deterministic set-state).
harness.dynamic_selectors: The two text boxes (Search for / Replace with) have per-session hashed winappcli slugs (txt-textbox-XXXX) that change on every launch; the harness resolves them at runtime via `winapp ui search` (type==Edit). All other controls use stable x:Name automationIds.
harness.reads: The `winapp ui search <text>` verb is used for all assertions (matches by accessible name, no hashed selectors). Absence is asserted POSITIVELY via the renamed-count label ((0)/(1)/(2)) because `search` exits non-zero on 0 matches.

green_baseline.note: Two consecutive clean-build runs, both 8/8 PASS with identical results — no flakiness.

regressions.change: In the simple search/replace loop, replaced `res = sourceToUse.replace(pos, searchTerm.length(), replaceTerm);` with `res = sourceToUse;` (no substitution).
regressions.note: Intended P0 check flipped PASS->FAIL (release gate FAIL). Additional failures are the other LITERAL-path checks — expected collateral for an engine-wide literal break; all regex-path checks stayed GREEN, confirming the fault was localized to the literal engine.

regressions.change: Replaced `const bool isCaseInsensitive = !(m_flags & CaseSensitive);` with `const bool isCaseInsensitive = true;` (Case sensitive checkbox ignored).
regressions.note: Isolated detection — only the intended check flipped.

regressions.change: Broke the padding regex: `padding=(\d+)` -> `padding=(z+)` so padding is never parsed (counter emitted without zero-padding).
Broke the group-token rewrite: `regex_replace(replaceTerm, otherGroupsRegex, L"$1$0$4")` -> `L"$1$0"` (drops the captured group number).
regressions.note: Isolated detection — $2_$1 transpose no longer produced 1_testCase / 2_testCase.

regressions.change: Forced first-only replacement: `if (!(m_flags & MatchAllOccurrences))` -> `if (!(m_flags & MatchAllOccurrences) || true)` (always break after first match).
regressions.note: Isolated detection — with Match-all on, t->f only replaced the first t (festCase1.txt) instead of all (fesfCase1.fxf).
